name: Mistral OCR Managed Parser
mechanism: Returns ordered structured document blocks with text, tables, images and coordinate information through a managed OCR and document-processing API.
use_when: Managed OCR with ordered blocks and bounding boxes is acceptable
PDF and image parsing should require minimal local infrastructure
avoid_when: Strict on-premise or unapproved cross-border processing applies
A provider-independent deterministic parser is required
failure_modes: Model alias or API revision changes output
Service limits or outages interrupt ingestion
